description: Paid: 0.02 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.02 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). For XRP Ledger users: x402 merchant readings for one payee by XRPL address: payments and unique payers in the last 24h from our own XRP Ledger scan, payer mix, account age, first funder and Domain field, endpoint liveness and 402 status, plus a modeled summary score (a measurement, not advice). Each reading lists its source and time. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

address.description: XRPL classic address of the payee (payTo) to report on

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_merchant_readings
title: x402 merchant readings (paid: 0.02 RLUSD or 0.02 USDC on Base via x402)
